english: Those are higurashi cicadas…?\nEarly summer in Japan-June, I wonder.
For now, let's head out to the main road.
Hey, Aria? What's wrong?\nYou look pale.
N-nothing.
Whoa, talk about the sticks!
Mmm, wonderful.\nYou can really taste the air here.
Aria?
It's nothing!\n…Just to be sure,\nthis is our first time here, right?
Obviously! I don't know a backwater like this.\nWe were trying to catch Dr. Shinigami in Rem's world,\nand that's how we ended up here.
Right! I know… I know.\nBut…
(What is this dread I'm feeling,\nthis fear… this revulsion…?\nAnd this inexplicable sadness…)
First we need to gather information\nabout this land.
There's a place name on the sign.\nUm… Hi-na-mi-za-wa?
Sorry, Rem! I feel bad, but\nlet me go solo.
Huh? What do you mean?
What are you suddenly talking about?\nIsn't splitting up a bad idea?
Please. Trust my instincts!\nNo, it's not just instinct.\nIt's closer to certainty-a flash of insight!
…I see. If Aria-chan says so,\nI think we should.
Are you sure?
Aria Kanzaki Holmes.\nDescendant of the great detective Sherlock Holmes-\nI believe in her intuition.
Thanks, Rem.\nI'll contact you if anything happens. Later!
Are we still not trusted\nas partners, indeed?
Isn't it the opposite?\nIt's because she trusts us that she can act separately.\nThat's what I think.
She's already gone.\nSuch drive-I might lose to it!
That's what geniuses are like.\nThey have a sensibility that catches\nwhat ordinary people can't. Probably.
Hello.
Everyone's dressed strangely…\nYou're not from Hinamizawa, are you?\nTravelers? Maybe? Maybe?
Yes, we just arrived.\nAre you from this village?
Yes. I'm Rena, Rena Ryugu.
Yo, Rena.\nWhat's up?
Ah, Mii-chan!
Heya. Rena's best friend,\nMion Sonozaki.\nThanks for taking care of our girll
Our girl?
Oh, I'm the club president…
Rem and the others left…
Rena Ryugu, Mion Sonozaki…\nI feel like I know those names.
She said she'd show us the sights,\nbut I feel like I know where that is.\nWhat is this…? I have to check…!
This is the Furude Shrine.\nProbably the place with the best view?
Wow, nice view!
Mion-chan, what's with that luggage?
We're all having lunch here!!\nBut it's not just any lunch!
Right… here… this shrine…
But why do I know?\nThis is definitely my first time here.\nWhy…
I don't understand…
Are you friends with Rem and the others too?
(When did this kid…!?\nI shouldn't have let my guard down…)
Nipaa☆
(I feel like I've met this kid too?)
Why are you hiding?\nI'd like you to come out.
Huh…?
Mii and Rena are both good kids.\nI'd like you to be friends with them.
I'm Rika Furude.\nDoes this name ring a bell?
No… but I feel like I know it…
Miii.\nYou may be\njust a little different.
Different? How?
Even I don't know that.
I see… listen,\nI want to keep going solo.\nCan you keep our meeting here a secret?
Understood.
Just one more time… Mii and Rena\nare very good kids.\nPlease don't forget that.
…Got it.
Well, I'll head back to everyone.\nNipaa☆
Huh, Rika-chan? Where'd you go?
I was talking with a cute kittyy
Hauu! Where's the cute kitty?
It already left.
Rem's group is fine for now. Next…
Hm! Someone's there…?
(That's Mion Sonozaki!?\nNo, wait. Mion was with Rem's group.\nThat is… that is… who…!)
Oh, whatever!
…Is someone there?
I won't say I'm not suspicious.\nBut I'd like to talk with you a bit, okay?
You're not from Hinamizawa, are you?
Right. You're not Mion Sonozaki, are you?
You know Mion?
I met her just now.\nYou look exactly like Mion, but you're not her.\nWho are you?
I'm Shion Sonozaki.\nMion is my older sister.
Shion… I see. You look so alike,\nI couldn't help but wonder.\nSo, what are you doing here?
…Now it's my turn to ask.\nYou're interested in the Furude Shrine's ritual storehouse,\naren't you?
The Furude Shrine's ritual storehouse…?
(Storehouse… it rings a bell… what was it?\nI'll just play along.)
Close, if not quite right?\nIf there's anything in this direction,\nit'd be the storehouse.
True. You're interested in the storehouse too, Shion?
(I might be able to use her. In that case…!)
You came to see the Watanagashi festival, right?\nWouldn't you like to hear\nan interesting story about Watanagashi?
Onikakushi…?
Yes. Every year at this time, one person dies,\none vanishes… "Onikakushi" happens\nbecause of Oyashiro-sama's curse.
(I feel like I've heard that word too.\nBut it's not clear… ugh, come on!)
Why tell ME that story?
Don't you want to know the truth about "Onikakushi"\nthat's inside the storehouse?
…You're planning to break in?
Yes. I have to know.\nTo save Satoko-chan.
Satoko!? Satoko, you mean that…?
If you know Mion, then you know?\nSatoko's uncle is a thug\nwho makes a living through threats and fraud.
He'd been living apart for a while,\nbut he suddenly came back, and now he's violent\ntoward Satoko-chan every day…
What a disgusting story…!\nWhy not just beat the crap out of him!
Satoko-chan believes that if she endures\nher uncle's abuse, her brother will return.\nShe thinks enduring is a trial…
So we outsiders\ncan't do a thing about it.
Only her real brother, Satoshi-kun, can save her.\nBut Satoshi-kun was made to vanish\nby the "Onikakushi"…
I see, so you're investigating the storehouse\nto find the secret of "Onikakushi".
Satoshi-kun asked me to look after Satoko-chan…\nI can't afford to be picky about methods.
You sure told a total stranger\nquite the story.
If you told the people of Hinamizawa what I'm doing,\nI'd be done for.
You're trying to win me over with sincerity, huh.\n…Fine, I'm in.
…Good.
We figured out how to open the storehouse lock, right?
Yes.
Then do the breaking in alone.\nDuring tomorrow's festival,\nI'll go to Satoko's house.
Satoko's uncle might go out.
I'll slip into the house then and snoop around.
Be careful.
(Good grief, this got weird.\nBut something's nagging at me…\nI don't know what, though.)
Someone's at Satoko's house…\nSatoko's at the Watanagashi festival,\nso it must be her uncle.
(Now, what to do.\nI can't just brute-force it\nand call it a day…)
//That lazy good-for-nothing! Off playing instead of working!
That voice… a real lowlife, by the sound of it.\nIf only he'd come out…
//Satokooo… when you come home, I'll love you real good…!
(Scumbag!\nHow can I flush him out of the house…)
//But first…
//I'll have some fun with the kitten in hiding first.
I know you're there. Come out.
Wh!? Why are YOU here!?
You disguised yourself as her uncle\nand abused Satoko!?\nWhat for!?
Hehehe… this village is a touch dull, you see.
Don't mess with me!\nNow that you've shown yourself, prepare yourself!!
Alone, you can do nothing, can you?\nThis place is far from the festival grounds.\nNo help will come.
Tch…!
That's a little naive, don't you thinkk?
Aria-san!
Shion! And Mion?
Shion told me everything.\nYou helped out for Satoko's sake, huh?\nAs club president, let me thank you!
Onee is reliable at times like this!
(Can I trust these two…?\nUgh, but right now!!)
Who the hell is that!?
Did you hear from Rem?\nThis is the criminal we've been chasing!\nHe was impersonating Satoko's uncle!
Oh? Lurking in Hinamizawa without greeting\nthe next head of the Sonozaki family-bold!\nI'll teach you how things are done!
You did that to Satoko-chan… I'll never forgive you!!
Beautiful sisters, I'll play with you too.\nCome at me.
Be careful! That guy, Dr. Shinigami-\nthere's no telling what he'll do!
I won't push my luck against an unknown enemy.\nA reckless hothead couldn't run\nthis club!
…About time.\nThis killing of time has gone on long enough.
You're running!? I won't let you!
Tch, they're trying to stall us!!
Aria-chan, I was looking for you!
Rem! Dr. Shinigami was here!\nLet's split up and search!
Really?
First we gotta take these guys out.\nNot a single one escapes!
Mou! Bad kids get punished, indeed!
No time, but\nat this point I'll show you\nmy special magic show!
Let's search for Dr. Shinigami!
Shion and I will check\nthat Rika-chan and Satoko are safe!
Aria-san, let's regroup later!
Not here… not here either, huh.
Strange, where could he be hiding?
How about your side?
No sign of him.
Rika-chama and Satoko-chan were safe.\nBut we're in trouble.
Without knowledge of the area,\nfurther searching will be hard…
The Watanagashi festival will be over soon.\nHe might make a move,\nso tonight let's prioritize guarding the festival grounds.
(Damn it, I let the culprit get away…!)
(In the end, nothing happened last night…)
Everyone!
Shion, what happened?
Rika-chama… Rika-chama…
Rika this time!?\nWhat happened?
Rika-chama was… murdered…
What…?
Her body was found at the shrine…\nwith her belly torn open…
No…!!
Behind the offertory box, Rika-chama…
(This is the gut-spilling…)
(Oyashiro-sama's curse…?\nBut why would the Furude Shrine's shrine maiden be cursed?\nThis really must be someone's doing…?)
This is… why…
It's Onikakushi.
Huh?
Rika died, and Satoko's uncle disappeared.\nOne died, one vanished.\nCan't we call this Onikakushi?
But Rika-chama being killed…\nOyashiro-sama couldn't want that…
Rika, are you there…?
Satoko-chan!? Don't come here!
Wh-what is this…
Rika!?
Noooo!!
Satoko-chan!
W-we have to follow her too!
She died… again…
(Huh… 'again'?\nDid I just say 'again'…?)
Ha, ha…
Haa, haa… cough cough.\nUgh, my throat…
No… it can't be true, Rika…
I can't take this anymore…
Satoko-chan, I finally caught up!
Ha… wh-who…?
It's okay, I won't do anything,\nplease calm down…
Nii-nii… is that you…?
Nii-nii?\nI-I'm…
…No…
You're not Nii-nii!\nDrop dead!
Drop dead…!!
S-Satoko-chan…!?
U… u…
Cough!\n…gah…
Satoko-cha… ngh!?
I-it hurts… I can't… breathe…
Uu… Nii-nii… Nii-nii…
Why… why…
